notes:
The tree the popup and the sidebar share steps each level in, sets its pack and group names a size up in the body ink over quieter prompt rows, runs flush to the edges with a flat rhythm, and the sidebar marks the open prompt again. Builds on [v0.2.24](https://github.com/bekalpaslan/promptline/releases/tag/v0.2.24).

### The tree, in both windows

- **Each level steps in.** A pack's own prompts and its groups' chevrons stand on the pack's name column, and a group's prompts on the group's name column, 24 px per level, so a group's prompts and the pack's own are told apart even when the group's header has scrolled off. In 0.2.24 every title stood on the chevron column.
- **Headers a size up, prompts a shade down.** Pack and group names are 14 px, over the prompt titles' 13, and both wear the body ink; prompt titles wear the secondary grey the counts use, so the headers are the bright lines and the prompts the quiet run under them. A group header is 24 px, a row's height; a pack's stays 28.
- **Flush rows, flat rhythm.** Rows run edge to edge with no side padding, so a pack's chevron sits 4 px in and counts, pins and key caps end on the edge; there is 2 px between packs, above a group and between rows, where 0.2.24 put 16 px between packs. The indent does the grouping that the air did. In the popup a pack's chevron no longer lines up with the search box's icon.

### Manager

- **The open prompt is marked.** Its row, and the header of the pack or group whose overview is showing, carry a grey fill a step heavier than the hover grey, no hue; the row the keyboard is on adds a thin hairline inside its edge, so a pointer resting on the tree is never mistaken for the cursor. 0.2.24 left the selection unmarked.
- Double-clicking a pack or group name to rename it keeps the text where the name stood instead of hopping right.
- Settings' hotkey help names only the default, Ctrl+Alt+V. An install that still has Ctrl+Shift+V keeps it, as before.

Nothing on disk changes, and the app sends nothing new over the network.
